text:
[Official] Pokémon Pokopia Music | 1-Hour Mix to Relax and Study to 💤
Find yourself a cosy spot and enjoy this 1-hour relaxing mix of music from Pokémon Pokopia. 

Join us as we move through this charming utopia accompanied by a calming compilation of official music that’s perfect to work, study and sleep to. 
 
Play as Ditto and build a new life with Pokémon in Pokémon Pokopia, available now!
